messages:
Sarah (sec-eng): Heads-up: external pen test window 2026-06-10 -> 2026-06-12. Need an ops checklist for handoff + a soft rollback corridor. Who can drive parts of this?
Mike (eng-sre): I can own the ops handoff and dry-run. Need concrete items: ephemeral RBAC, KMS scoping, audit exports, evidence packaging, and rollback steps.
Ashwin (infra): On RBAC: propose an OIDC-backed ephemeral role 'assessor-readonly' with 8h TTL, MFA enforced, and source IP allowlist. We should scope policies to read-only on namespaces and logs. Anyone object to TTL?
Olivia (sec-ops): TTL=8h is fine. KMS: create a dedicated key with a restrictive key policy. Grant Decrypt only for the assessor principal; no DecryptToPlaintext outside grants. Also deny key scheduling/deletion for that role. Ship key usage logs to the secure audit bucket.
Alex (devex): Evidence packaging: prefer presigned S3 URLs + a JSON manifest. I'll provide a small helper script. Example upload command for assessors:
```bash
aws s3 cp evidence/ s3://redwood-pt-evidence/assessor-<id>/ --recursive --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```
Include manifest schema and checksum.
Sarah (sec-eng): CloudTrail: keep events for 180 days in the short-term retention bucket, then archive to cold storage. Add alert rule for any principal invoking DeleteBucket, kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion, or iam:PutRolePolicy.
pen-test-bot: :robot_face: Reminder: runbook + evidence manifest required 48h before window.
Mike (eng-sre): Question: rollback corridor — proposal: soft rollback = revoke assessor roles + rotate ephemeral token provider, failover to staging endpoints for production-facing routes, and stop any evidence exports. Hard rollback (last resort) = rollback recent infra config commits and revert feature flags. Thoughts?
Ashwin (infra): Agree. For revoking assessor access quickly we will publish a short TTL policy and prepare a one-click revoke that toggles an allowlist flag in our auth service. Example IAM snippet to restrict s3 and logs for the role:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"]
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": ["s3:DeleteObject","s3:PutBucketPolicy"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"]
    }
  ]
}
```
Make sure the key policy only allows kms:Decrypt via granted grants.
Olivia (sec-ops): Triage plan: we will spawn a vuln tracker ticket per finding and tag with 'pt-critical'/'pt-high', and escalate to on-call if exploitable in prod. Triage lead will be @Olivia. Tracker template: summary, PoC, risk, repro steps, affected assets, mitigation patch/rollback.
Alex (devex): I'll create the evidence manifest template + upload helper and put it in the runbook repo. Will also include sample presign TTL=48h.
Sarah (sec-eng): Owners: Mike = ops/dry-run + revoke flow; Ashwin = RBAC/KMS changes + scripts; Alex = evidence packaging + docs; Olivia = triage lead. I'll draft a short runbook and post it tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
Mike (eng-sre): Scheduling dry-run: 2026-06-08 17:00 UTC. pen-test-bot, can you post a calendar invite to #eng-sre and #eng-security?
pen-test-bot: Scheduled dry-run 2026-06-08 17:00 UTC. Invite sent to #eng-sre, #eng-security.
Sarah (sec-eng): One more ask: preserve audit snapshots (CloudTrail + KMS logs + ALB logs) for the full engagement window before archive. We'll need a packaged evidence bundle for the assessor retest.
Olivia (sec-ops): Noted. I'll add retention checklist and evidence manifest fields for log ranges.
Mike (eng-sre): Great — I'll run the dry-run and report back with any gaps.
Sarah (sec-eng): Thanks team — we'll reconvene after the dry-run to finalize the rollback playbook and final access window.
